node.title: Re^3: Many children, but never more than a fixed number at once.
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Hello Paolo and welcome to the Monastery. I would recommend [id://101|registering an account], and also posting new questions as new posts in [id://479], since they will get more visibility there (the post you are replying to is ~16 years old). I have considered this node for moving there, so you don't need to repost it.
